title: Trump says US destroying Iranian mine-laying boats
summary: The U.S. military "eliminated" 16 Iranian mine-laying vessels near the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, the U.S. Central Command said in a statement, as President Donald Trump warned that any ​mines laid in ‌the Strait by Iran must be removed immediately.
